title: Renal Clearance: GFR, Filtration Fraction and Transport
subject: Physiology
preview: Renal clearance is the hypothetical plasma volume from which a substance is completely removed per unit time.
quickRevision: Renal clearance is the hypothetical plasma volume from which a substance is completely removed per unit time.
Creatinine clearance can modestly overestimate true GFR due to tubular secretion.
Filtration fraction is GFR divided by renal plasma flow; transport maximum describes saturation of certain tubular processes.

sections.title: Core biomedical mechanism
points: Renal clearance is the hypothetical plasma volume from which a substance is completely removed per unit time.
Inulin clearance approximates GFR because it is freely filtered without meaningful reabsorption or secretion.

sections.title: Clinical application
points: Creatinine clearance can modestly overestimate true GFR due to tubular secretion.
Filtration fraction is GFR divided by renal plasma flow; transport maximum describes saturation of certain tubular processes.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Clearance of a substance undergoing active secretion is not automatically identical to GFR.
